caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed, two-handled silver cup set against a plain, light-colored background. The cup is rendered in gray shading and fine detail, with a smooth, reflective surface and gently flared sides. Each handle is attached at the rim and base, curving outward then looping inward in a circular form before attaching to the body. There is a subtle inscription across the front reading “Mary Sybil Kimbro.” The cup sits on a small, slightly raised circular base. The composition includes faint pencil lines suggesting a border close to the edges of the paper, and a signature at the lower right that reads "Amelia Turco 1936." There is also a faint embossed or stamped emblem in the top right corner. The overall image is monochromatic, rendered primarily in shades of gray.
title: Silver Bowl
